## Delivery Models
- Powered Shell: Energized 230kV/400kV substation and shell handover for hyperscalers.
- Turnkey Build-to-Suit (BTS): Bespoke engineering, cleanrooms, and construction with guaranteed COD.
- Institutional Joint Venture (JV): Single-SPV co-development with global private equity and sovereign wealth funds.
